$comment: AFLDB-ISSUE-222 Phase F disjoint new-salt bridge VALIDATION sample (runbook §3.5 item 4). One random stratum drawn on the v2 SOURCE-EVIDENCE parent, excluding the census and every previously reviewed/adjudicated person. UNREVIEWED: verdicts are recorded in a separate versioned artefact and this file is never edited. It authorises no import, no database connection, no network request and no DEV/PROD action.

frame.basis: v2 source-evidence parent bridges[] (never the deployment child)
frame.exclusion_policy: census excluded (reviewed exhaustively under v1; re-checked only per mechanism, §3.5 item 4); v1 census + v1 random excluded (disjoint redraw); the 83 operator-adjudicated pack persons excluded ('prior discovery rows')

generated_utc_basis: frozen to the validated v2 afldb_test child's generated_utc (the moment bridge-v2 eligibility was frozen) so this artefact is byte-reproducible; not a wall-clock generation time
label: 20260918-v2
not_performed: any review verdict (the sample is UNREVIEWED)
any modification of the v1/v2 parent, child, prior sample or verdict artefacts
ordering: sha256(salt + "|" + player_url) hex ascending, ties by player_url

review.criterion: same human, not same club (AFLDB-ISSUE-222.md §3.5); 0 failures required
review.verdict_storage: separate versioned artefact bridge-validation-verdicts-20260918-v2.json; this sample is never edited
review.voids_sample: any change to a tool hash, input hash, salt, n or rule

zero_failure_bound.formula: 1 - 0.05^(1/n)  (one-sided 95% upper bound on the error rate at 0 failures)
zero_failure_bound.note: achieved only if every reviewed row is same-person; stated beside the observed count, never rounded to '99.9%'; the census contributes no bound
